KNOWN AS THE SOCIAL SECURITY ACT OF 2018
rows.abstract:
Proposes to amend Sec. 14-B of R.A. 11199 which shall be read as follows:
Section 14-B. Unemployment Insurance - A member who is not over sixty (60) years of age who has paid at least thirty-six (36) months contributions twelve (12) months of which should be in the eighteen months immediately preceding the unemployment shall be paid benefits in the form of monthly cash payments equivalent to fifty (50%) of the average monthly salary credit for a maximum of two (2) months.
Intends to mandate the Social Security Commission to amend the Implementing Rules and Regulations of the existing law.

rows.author: J095
rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROVIDING FOR CERTAIN EXEMPTIONS FROM NATIONAL
INTERNAL REVENUE TAXES, AND A SIMPLIFIED BUSINESS
REGISTRATION PROCESS FOR SMALL-TIME ONLINE SELLERS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to categorize online sellers (any Filipino citizen who conducts online business exclusively through electronic channels including but not limited to social media, online shopping platforms, and online marketplaces) where the gross income from the conduct of the sale of goods or services is as follows:

1.	small scale online seller - does not exceed PhP 150,000.00 annually
2.	medium scale online seller - more than PhP150,000.00 but does not exceed Php 250,000.00 annually
3.	large scale online seller - exceeds PhP 250,000.00 but not more than PhP 3,000,000.00 annually

Proposes for: exemption and tax liabilities of online sellers (per category) from national internal revenue taxes such as income tax and Other Percentage Taxeswaiver of the registration fee for small and medium scale online sellers; and complete migration of the registration process to electronic modes for all small-time online sellers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2020-07-28

rows.author: J071
rows.title_full:
AN ACT ADJUSTING THE MINIMUM AMOUNT FOR DEATH INDEMNITY, MORAL AND EXEMPLARY DAMAGES UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 386 OR THE CIVIL CODE OF THE
PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Proposes the following amendments:
SECTION 1. Article 2206 of Republic Act No. 386, ”¦ is hereby amended to read as follows:
       ART. 2206.  The amount of damages for death caused by a crime or quasi-delict SHALL BE AT LEAST THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS even though there may have been mitigating circumstances.  THE COURT, IN ITS DISCRETION, MAY AWARD A HIGHER AMOUNT, BASED ON THE RATE OF INFLATION AND THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF EACH CASE.”
       
SECTION 2. Article 2216 of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
       ART. 2216. ”¦ PROVIDED, THAT THE AMOUNT OF MORAL AND EXEMPLARY DAMAGES SHALL BE AT LEAST TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS IN CASES OF DEATH RESULTING FROM A CRIME OR QUASI-DELICT.  THE COURT, IN ITS DISCRETION, MAY AWARD A HIGHER AMOUNT BASED ON PREVAILING CIRCUMSTANCES AND THE RATE OF INFLATION.”
